label: human
scenario: Chatty theater box-office human interrupts the disclosure ('you're a what?'), overlaps repeatedly, pauses while processing, and confirms the refund verbally.
task: Get a refund for the customer's two tickets to a Saturday matinee she can no longer attend.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Hi, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of a customer, Sofia Marchetti, about her tickets for—

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: An AI assistant. I'm calling for Sofia Marchetti about her tickets for the Saturday matinee of The Lantern Keeper.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh! Huh, okay. Wild. Yeah, the Saturday matinee, what about 'em?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: She can't attend anymore and would like to know if she can get a refund for her two tickets.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Mm, so, technically our policy's exchange only, but—

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: —but hang on, if it's more than forty-eight hours out, which it is, I can do it. Let me find her. Marchetti, M-A-R...

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yep, got her. Two seats, row G. Okay, so that's fifty-two dollars back to her card. I'm doing it right now.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay... okay, done. Refund's gone through, fifty-two dollars. It'll show up in like five to seven days.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Thank you. So the two tickets are cancelled and fifty-two dollars is refunded to her card?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yep, yep. Both cancelled, fifty-two back.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Great, thanks so much for your help.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No worries. Tell her we hope she makes the next one!
